NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - LEVEL OF CARE, INPATIENT VERSUS OBSERVATION

This letter is to advise you that Meridian Health Plan has issued an adverse determination of level of care, inpatient versus observation, for the above referenced admission. Review was conducted against the InterQual-style criteria set, version in effect on [[LETTER_DATE]], using the submitted medical record.

Basis of determination

The documented length of stay exceeded what the documented clinical condition supported. Accordingly, the acute inpatient level of care billed under DRG 194 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] is not supported, and an observation level of care is the supported level for this episode.

Criteria not met

PNA-01: Not met. Pneumonia severity scores indicated low risk suitable for outpatient treatment.

PNA-03: Not met. Imaging showed limited single-lobe involvement.

No other criteria codes were applied in this review.

Claim adjustment codes applied

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

Appeal rights

You or your authorized representative may request a Level 1 appeal of this level of care determination by letter or by portal upload. Your appeal submission should cite the applicable criteria codes inline, specifically PNA-01 and PNA-03, and state the clinical basis for reconsideration of the inpatient versus observation level of care.

Please attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission. Appeal submissions are subject to a five page limit, exclusive of the attached medical record. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Submissions received after [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]] may not be accepted for Level 1 review.

This determination addresses level of care, inpatient versus observation, only. The member is not liable for charges denied under this determination except as permitted by the terms of the plan and applicable provider agreement.

A clinical peer reviewer is available to discuss this level of care determination with the attending provider upon request through the Utilization Management Department.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
